title: Probo task specification, schema version 0
description: One task: a repository at a pinned base commit, an instruction, hidden tests, a gold patch, the Fail-to-Pass and Pass-to-Pass test IDs, an executable verification spec, timeouts and source metadata. Lives in probo.toml next to instruction.md, gold.patch and hidden/. The converter emits Harbor's task layout from it.

id.description: Stable task ID. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

difficulty.description: Optional label. The measured proxy is the gold patch size, computed by validate-task.

language.description: What the module under test is. kotlin-jvm is a pure JVM Gradle project (no Android plugin).

pack_version.description: Semver of the task pack this task ships in.

repo.description: Upstream repository URL, or 'fixture' for harness fixtures.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the source repository.

base_commit.description: Pinned base commit (full SHA for real repositories; any marker for fixtures).

merge_date.description: Merge date of the upstream fix, for the contamination split.

attribution.description: One paragraph task card text with attribution.

docker_image.description: Per-repo image reference, by digest, with the repository at /app at the base commit. Mutually exclusive with repo_dir.

repo_dir.description: Task-relative directory holding the repository (fixtures). The converter generates a Dockerfile around it. Mutually exclusive with docker_image.

base_image.description: Base image for the generated Dockerfile (repo_dir tasks only).

agent_user.description: Non-root user for the agent phase ([agent].user in task.toml). Unset until verified on Docker (P0-C).

test_tasks.description: Fully qualified Gradle test task paths, e.g. ':test' or ':app:testDemoDebugUnitTest'. Only these run.

results_dirs.description: Override of the JUnit XML directories derived from test_tasks.

hidden_tests.description: Repository-relative paths overwritten from the task's hidden/ directory before grading.

f2p.description: Fail-to-Pass test IDs as classname#name (JUnit method names without trailing parentheses).

extra_protected.description: Task-level regular expressions; matching paths count as build-file tampering.

test_command.description: The command the instruction recommends to the agent.

interface_contract.description: Public symbols the hidden tests reference, appended to the instruction.

patch.description: Task-relative path of the gold patch applied by the oracle.
